question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the given meaning

Considering everything
solution:
The correct answer is "**All in all.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given idioms:
 
 
• **"All in All" means everything considered or we use all in all to introduce a summary or general statement.**
